'''Raythen Predot''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He worked for the [[VerveGen Corporation]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], which in turn was a part of the [[Eagle's network]]. He was killed by an [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]], who infiltrated VerveGen around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />
